messages:
ashley: Heads-up: release window in ~3.5h. We need to sync Help Center publish + SDK docs regen for branch release/v1.14.0. Hard cutoff 18:00 UTC. Changelog bump required in /changelogs/unreleased.md under a "Console & SDK" section. Who can take which parts?

sam: I can do the SDK docs regen and push the docs artifacts. Plan to bump package.json to 1.14.0 in the same PR and add the changelog entry. Which commits should be included? Do we pin the SDK package to 1.14.0 right away?

mike: I'll handle Help Center publish + quick prod smoke. Doing a canary in eu-west-1 first. Can someone paste the exact publish commands to follow?

jordan: I'll do the branch cut at cutoff and push tags. Workflow: cut release/v1.14.0 at 18:00 UTC, tag v1.14.0-rc1, run smoke, then promote to v1.14.0. Will post the branch SHA here after cut.

laura: I'll run a full staging smoke once both docs and site are live (login flows, SDK quickstart, embeddings demo). Give me ~30m after deploy.

ashley: Sam - use the regen script: `scripts/regen_sdk_docs.sh --all` then `yarn publish-docs --site=helpcenter --env=prod`. Add redirect from `/docs/legacy-auth` to `/docs/auth/migration` in site-config.yaml and note the client param rename in changelog (keep timeout_ms for compat, prefer timeout_ms). Put the changelog entry in the same PR as the regen + version bump.

sam: Copy that. I'll include the redirect and changelog. Opening PR once regen completes.

mike: Planned publish steps:
```
# build helpcenter
yarn workspace @redwood/helpcenter build
# publish
./scripts/publish_site --site=helpcenter --env=prod --canary-region=eu-west-1
```
I'll lock content for writes 10m before the publish start.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled helpcenter publish window at 1767777600; enforcing content lock 10m before start.

ashley: Also note: changelog heading should be "Console & SDK" and include a short bullet about the redirect + param note.

sam: Regeneration in progress. Will target only commits up to merge-base with main at cutoff. PR will be sdk/pull/1623.

mike: Canary done in eu-west-1: no 500s, CDN responses good, but found a broken anchor at `/sdk/auth#session` — looks like a slug mismatch in the new md. Patching now and re-running canary.

laura: Staging smoke checklist (when ready): login, api-key creation, sdk quickstart run, embeddings page sanity, docs search. I'll post results as a short list.

jordan: Branch cut plan: I'll create release/v1.14.0 at 1767776800 (18:00 UTC). After that, freeze non-critical merges; emergency fixes only to be cherry-picked.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1623 — includes sdk docs regen, package.json bump to 1.14.0, changelog update. CI running, needs docs + one code approval.

ashley: I'll review after CI passes. @mike confirm canary/prod clean before I authorize final tag promotion.

mike: Prod publish started (1767777500) rolling across 3 nodes. Will report status when CDN invalidation queued.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting prod publish for helpcenter at 1767777500  rolling to 3 nodes, will report progress.

mike: Prod publish finished at 1767777540. CDN purge queued for 10m. Site pages return 200. Fixed anchor and added redirect.

sam: SDK docs published and linked from Help Center. Quickstart code examples render; code snippets linted. SDK docs tag pushed.

laura: Staging smoke results: login  OK, SDK quickstart OK, embeddings demo OK, docs search OK, flaky session-timeout test recorded (ticket #789). Attaching short notes to PR 1623.

jordan: Branch release/v1.14.0 created at sha abc123def. Tag v1.14.0-rc1 pushed. Will promote to v1.14.0 after final confirmation from ashley.

sam: Merged PR 1623 after approvals; CI green. Docs are live.

ashley: All good — thanks team. I'll assemble release notes, mark changelog entry as released, and ping comms/legal. If anything else pops up, reply in #eng-releases and tag me.

mike: Minor follow-up: one trailing 404 on an old /guides/ page; filed ticket #790. Not critical for this release.

laura: Closing notes: smoke passes except ticket #789 (session timeout flake). Will add follow-up items to next milestone.

jordan: Promoted v1.14.0-rc1 -> v1.14.0 and pushed final tag at sha abc123def. Release complete."
